caption: Moffatt lacks admitted paired replicate contrasts. Repeatability comes from the frozen failure audit; support histograms use the current matched historical training-pair roster.
H0/P1/P2 share candidates and sequence features; targets can differ due to replicate uncertainty and raw-versus-author processing. The Hraw control separates those explanations.
Fixed ten-bin reliability curves. Moffatt uses aggregate labels only and cannot establish replicated probability calibration. Pair probabilities do not imply absolute benefit over WT.
Lower regret and positive gain are better. Primary supervision methods share the fixed interaction_3 representation and original study/component balance. A pooled gain alone cannot pass.
Stacked categories sum to overall wrong direction. Replicate ambiguity overlaps these categories and is reported separately, never used to erase errors.
The reliability association has n=3 and is not mechanistic proof. Secondary variants cannot rescue a failed primary supervision gate.
All bars use matched candidate subsets and raw held-replicate targets. The measured-replicate reference is neither deployable nor a theoretical maximum.
